collection.title: Renault Modus Grand Modus MPV 2008 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Renault Modus Grand Modus MPV 2008 to 2013 will fit, this model requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 25" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Modus which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
